ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels to 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white blobs cover the distal 2/3 of both lobes. A low-intensity dark wedge is centered at the proximal peduncle junction. Dense dark stippling and small circular spots are mapped across the medial regions and along the interior trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center; estimated interior angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency serrations interrupted by a large semi-circular excision on the medial-distal right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory curving upward and outward toward acute, recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several dark, circular clusters (3-10 pixels diameter) scattered on white regions; notable groupings on the distal right lobe and mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three parallel dark linear streaks on the upper quadrant of the left lobe; one prominent vertical dark line located near the lower-medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major semi-circular traumatic excision on the trailing edge of the right lobe; numerous irregular nicks and secondary jagged serrations along the trailing margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique stippled 'salt-and-pepper' pixel transition zone at the interface between the central dark pigmentation and the white distal lobes.
